verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de exposes webhooks and named events (e.g. `appointment.completed`, notarization completion) with HMAC signature verification, letting external systems react automatically to platform events. However, there is no evidence of a native rules/trigger builder within Beglaubigt.de itself—automation logic must be implemented entirely in the customer's own system consuming webhooks, not defined as declarative rules in the product. Missing for 10: an in-product rule/condition builder, evidence of configurable trigger-action pairs, and any UI/API for defining 'if event X then do Y' logic beyond raw webhook delivery.
